name: pi-search-multi
description: Unified web search extension for pi with 9 backend providers — DuckDuckGo, Marginalia, Serper, Brave, Tavily, Exa, Firecrawl, LangSearch, and WebSearchAPI.ai. Auto-fallback, rate limiting, and secure key storage.
